has been out with the football team who have all

tender moment when each hopeful player closes his
eyes and leans forward with quivering lips.
Unfortunately Veronica's parents heard them
clumping down the road and Veronica knows she
only has time to kiss four out of the eleven of them
if she's going to do it properly.
